name: Nolton Cross Holiday Park
accommodation: Seven static caravans sleeping up to 6, plus 15 touring and tent pitches
dogs: Welcome on lead; three caravans dog-friendly (Visit Wales)
confirmedFeatures: Hot showers, launderette, play area, BBQ area, Wi-Fi, hook-ups
overview: Nolton Cross is a family-run park 1.5 miles inland of Nolton Haven with seven caravans and 15 pitches.
surfTripFit: A low-cost base a couple of minutes' drive from Nolton Haven and Newgale.
